_comment: Which hosts a Markdown reader may fetch images from without asking (MarkdownDocumentView with showsImages, first used by StoryMaker's Read view, 2026-10-03). Opening a chapter must not ping an arbitrary server: an image from any host not listed here renders as a link instead, the way mail readers hold back remote images. Local files always load. Content, so a host is added by PR with no rebuild. thumb.wikimedia.org added 2026-10-04: the Commons API now returns its scaled copies (thumburl) from that host, so four of the pilot's six pictures rendered as links.
